TCP_PORTS.description: TCP ports to monitor for scanning.

UDP_PORTS.description: UDP ports to monitor for scanning.

ADVANCED_PORTS_TCP.description: Number of ports below this value to monitor in Advanced TCP mode.

ADVANCED_PORTS_UDP.description: Number of ports below this value to monitor in Advanced UDP mode.

RESOLVE_HOST.description: Enable DNS lookups for attacking hosts ('1') or disable ('0').

BLOCK_UDP.description: Action for UDP scans: 0 (Do not block), 1 (Block), 2 (Run external command only).

BLOCK_TCP.description: Action for TCP scans: 0 (Do not block), 1 (Block), 2 (Run external command only).

KILL_ROUTE.description: Command to drop the route or block the host.

KILL_HOSTS_DENY.description: Text to drop into hosts.deny for TCP Wrappers.

SCAN_TRIGGER.description: Number of port connects allowed before an alarm is given.
